#include <iostream>

using namespace std;

 

struct Book {

    int id;

    string title;

    Book* prev;

    Book* next;

};

 

void insertAfterK(Book*& head, int k, int id, string title) {

    Book* newNode = new Book{id, title, nullptr, nullptr};

   

    if (head == nullptr) {

        if (k == 0) {

            head = newNode;

        } else {

            cout << "Invalid position.\n";

            delete newNode;

        }

        return;

    }

 

    Book* temp = head;

    int count = 1;

 

    while (temp != nullptr && count < k) {

        temp = temp->next;

        count++;

    }

 

    if (temp == nullptr) {

        cout << "Position exceeds list length.\n";

        delete newNode;

        return;

    }

 

    newNode->next = temp->next;

    newNode->prev = temp;

 

    if (temp->next != nullptr) {

        temp->next->prev = newNode;

    }

 

    temp->next = newNode;

}

#include <iostream>

using namespace std;

 

struct Ticket {

    int ticketNo;

    string passengerName;

    Ticket* prev;

    Ticket* next;

};

 

// Function to insert at the end of the list

void insertAtEnd(Ticket*& head, int ticketNo, string passengerName) {

    Ticket* newNode = new Ticket{ticketNo, passengerName, nullptr, nullptr};

 

    // Case 1: Empty list

    if (head == nullptr) {

        head = newNode;

        return;

    }

 

    // Case 2: Traverse to the last node

    Ticket* temp = head;

    while (temp->next != nullptr) {

        temp = temp->next;

    }

 

    // Adjust pointers

    temp->next = newNode;

    newNode->prev = temp;

}

#include <stdio.h>

#include <stdlib.h>

 

// Node structure representing a player

struct Player {

    int id;

    struct Player* next;

};

 

// Function to insert at end (used for setup)

void insertAtEnd(struct Player** head, int id) {

    struct Player* newNode = (struct Player*)malloc(sizeof(struct Player));

    newNode->id = id;

 

    if (*head == NULL) {

        newNode->next = newNode;

        *head = newNode;

        return;

    }

 

    struct Player* temp = *head;

    while (temp->next != *head) {

        temp = temp->next;

    }

    temp->next = newNode;

    newNode->next = *head;

}

 

// Function to delete from beginning

void deleteFromBeginning(struct Player** head) {

    if (*head == NULL) {

        printf("Lobby is empty.\n");

        return;

    }

 

    struct Player* temp = *head;

 

    // Only one player

    if ((*head)->next == *head) {

        printf("Deleted player: %d (host)\n", temp->id);

        free(temp);

        *head = NULL;

        return;

    }

 

    struct Player* last = *head;

    while (last->next != *head)

        last = last->next;

 

    printf("Deleted player: %d (host)\n", (*head)->id);

    last->next = (*head)->next;

    *head = (*head)->next;

    free(temp);

}

 

// Function to delete from end

void deleteFromEnd(struct Player** head) {

    if (*head == NULL) {

        printf("Lobby is empty.\n");

        return;

    }

 

    struct Player* temp = *head;

 

    // Only one player

    if (temp->next == *head) {

        printf("Deleted player: %d (last remaining)\n", temp->id);

        free(temp);

        *head = NULL;

        return;

    }

 

    struct Player* prev = NULL;

    while (temp->next != *head) {

        prev = temp;

        temp = temp->next;

    }

 

    printf("Deleted player: %d (last player)\n", temp->id);

    prev->next = *head;

    free(temp);

}

 

// Function to display the lobby

void displayLobby(struct Player* head) {

    if (head == NULL) {

        printf("Lobby is empty.\n");

        return;

    }

 

    struct Player* temp = head;

    printf("Players in lobby: ");

    do {

        printf("%d -> ", temp->id);

        temp = temp->next;

    } while (temp != head);

    printf("(back to host)\n");

}

 

// Main function

int main() {

    struct Player* lobby = NULL;

 

    // Add some players

    insertAtEnd(&lobby, 1); // Host

    insertAtEnd(&lobby, 2);

    insertAtEnd(&lobby, 3);

    insertAtEnd(&lobby, 4);

 

    displayLobby(lobby);

 

    // Host leaves

    deleteFromBeginning(&lobby);

    displayLobby(lobby);

 

    // Last player leaves

    deleteFromEnd(&lobby);

    displayLobby(lobby);

 

    return 0;

}
